summary: Phathom Pharmaceuticals filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce initiation of patient screening in pHalcon-NERD-302, a Phase 3 registrational trial of as-needed VOQUEZNA (vonoprazan) 10 mg in adults with Non-Erosive GERD. The multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study plans roughly 500 patients across about 80 U.S. sites, with a four-week open-label run-in, 1:1 randomization, 24 weeks of treatment, and a Week 12 primary endpoint. Topline results are expected in Q1 2028. This is an ordinary clinical/regulatory update, not a special situation.
